templatesDiscover.title: Browse the template catalog
templatesDiscover.emptyOffline: No catalog to show — AWOG could not reach it and there is no cached copy yet. Reconnect and refresh, or use "Fetch from GitHub" with a link you already trust.
templatesDiscover.curatedNote: This is a curated list published by AWOG. Anything outside it still installs through "Fetch from GitHub".
templatesDiscover.consent.title: Review before installing
templatesDiscover.consent.risk.hook: Hooks are scripts. Nothing runs on install, and every hook lands unapproved — you have to approve it yourself, per project, before it can run.
templatesDiscover.consent.risk.rule: Rules go straight into the system prompt of every turn in the projects you install them into.
templatesDiscover.consent.undisclosedTit: The listing did not mention everything
templatesDiscover.consent.stagingNote: Installing only adds the bundle to your template library. Nothing reaches a project until you install it into one.
templatesDiscover.consent.sourceChanged: The source changed while you were reading it. Nothing was written — this is the new content.
